findings.subject: joints register (PR #23) bolt holes
findings.message: With Ø6.6 clearance holes and an M6 bolt (major diameter 5.974 max, ISO 965-1 6g) the float is 0.31 mm radial. The rivnut can sit up to 0.07 off in its Ø9.53 +0.10 hole (Sherex body Ø9.50 max), leaving 0.24 mm for both hole positions: about ±0.12 mm each (Ø0.24 positional from the spigot hole), which needs CNC or a drill jig. The register gives no hole position tolerance. Spigot play doesn't add: the panel shifts to the bolts within it.
findings.fix: State ±0.12 (Ø0.24 positional) in the register for the WALL and CEILING drawings, or open the clearance holes to Ø7.0 (float 0.51, about ±0.22 each). Stack ST-03.

findings.subject: sample package P06, P07
findings.message: The wall-and-door sample parts list (v2/06-Samples/wall-door-sample/parts-list.md on main, and still in PR #29) buys 25 x M6 x 50 ISO 4017 hex bolts (P06) and ISO 7089 washers (P07), sized to pass through a 40 mm member. The decided joint is M6 x 16 ISO 4762 socket head (PM ruling R-J2), driven from inside the member into the Sherex rivnut, with a 1.5 mm aluminium stop washer under the rivnut head and 7.0 mm clearance holes (joints register 2.1, 2.2; F-009 ruling). Built from this list, the sample tests a different joint and the factory buys the wrong bolts.
findings.fix: Update P06 to M6 x 16 ISO 4762 class 8.8 zinc and replace P07 with the H-08 stop washer (and the H-02 captive retainer, HOLD), in PR #29 or right after PR #23 merges.
